**Finding: compliant** (Rule INDEMN — Indemnification by Vendor)

Section 14.2(B) gives us a real vendor-side defence and indemnity, expressly including third-party IP infringement claims against the Services and M&I's software, plus M&I's legal violations and loss from its acts or omissions, with standard procedures in 14.3. It meets the preferred position on scope and is not redlined.

Noted for the record (not flagged): no express Customer Data breach limb, the reciprocal Customer indemnity in 14.2(A) is broader than our preferred narrow form, and the "notwithstanding any provision" 3-month liability cap in 13.4 would cut into the indemnity — that cap belongs to the limitation-of-liability rule.
